events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th to comedy legend John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album'! A double album that broke all the rules and gave us so many classics. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: On the anniversary of his passing, we remember Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. A voice that defied limits and a stage presence unmatched. He would have been 80. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic step for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles gave us the groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul'! An album that pushed boundaries and delivered timeless tracks. What's your top pick from the record?

events.title: Tribute to John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: On the anniversary of his tragic death, we remember The Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of John Lennon today. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. He would have been 86. What does his legacy mean to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic British musician, songwriter, and actor David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: The legendary David Bowie would have been 80 today. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself and music. What's your favourite Bowie era or song?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy heavenly 92nd birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley! His music still moves generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history with Led Zeppelin. What's your favourite Page guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer and songwriter Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! That distinctive voice has given us decades of hits. What's your favourite Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of the iconic British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable voice of Madness! From 'Our House' to 'Baggy Trousers', what's your top Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his distinctive soulful voice and 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: 80s Soulman
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That incredible voice gave us some of the greatest hits of the 80s. What's your favourite from him?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the beloved American country music icon, singer-songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: The legendary Dolly Parton would have been 81 today. A true superstar whose music and spirit continue to inspire millions. What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting maestro, what's your favourite Gary moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the soulful Billy Ocean! His feel-good hits are still guaranteed to get you dancing. What's your favourite Billy Ocean track?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction (1989)
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held on this day in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock History Made
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction! Which legendary artists were in that inaugural class, and who do you think deserves to be in now?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter and Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! A key part of Take That's enduring success. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment, solo or with the band?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert! An iconic moment in music. What's your favourite track from that performance?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The English drummer, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, he's given us so many unforgettable songs. What's your favourite?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: The renowned English actor Hugh Grant, known for his charming roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Romantic Comedy King
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the brilliant Hugh Grant! From 'Notting Hill' to 'Four Weddings', his charm is undeniable. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to pop superstar Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to his incredible solo career, he's a true entertainer. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved English actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy Trotter and Detective Inspector Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Frost, his characters are iconic. What's your favourite David Jason role?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' (1959)
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash, an event known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 'The Day The Music Died'. Their influence lives on. What's your favourite song from these pioneers?

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The English singer, songwriter, and 80s pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' on his infectious pop. What's your favourite Rick Astley hit?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Remembering the Jamaican reggae legend Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Reggae Royalty
angles.copy: The iconic Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His message of peace, love, and unity continues to inspire. What's your favourite Bob Marley song?
